title: Ordering breakfast
instructions: Bir kadın kafede kahvaltı sipariş ediyor. Ne istediğine ve neyi istemediğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: Good morning. What can I get you?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: I'd like eggs and toast, please.

script.speaker: waiter
script.text: How would you like your eggs?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Fried, please. But no butter on the toast.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: A cup of tea with milk, please. No sugar.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Yes, an orange juice too, please.
